$comment: SNAPSHOTS of the curve template arcnow.io's platform serves, and the gate that keeps them honest.
READ THE TEMPLATE FROM THE CHAIN. A curve template is per-platform state, settable at any
time by that platform's admin, and snapshotted immutably onto every curve at launch. The
authoritative answer for 'what will a new launch get' is PlatformConfig.curveParametersFor(quote); for
'what did THIS token get' it is the curve itself, and never this file.
ONE CURVE, ONE TEMPLATE PER QUOTE (schemaVersion 4). Every template is the constant-product curve's:
its fourth field is y0Wad, and `quote` names the quote token it is denominated in (native USDC is
0x000...000). r0Wad, targetQuoteWad and initialPriceWad are in that quote's WAD units.
WHAT EACH ENTRY IS. 'platform' non-null: a snapshot of that live platform, read at readAtBlock,
which scripts/check-template.sh reads back and FAILS on any difference, and on a platform whose
VERSION() is not platform-config@3.x.x. The network's arcnowPlatform must have one. 'platform'
null: a template no live platform serves, shipped as a starting point and checked field by field
against the vectors.json template named by vectorsTemplate, so it is never trusted unchecked.
MOVING THIS FILE is a commit of its own: change the values, run scripts/sync-artifacts.sh and
scripts/check-template.sh, and say what moved on chain. Every wad is a STRING because y0Wad does
not fit in a double and JSON has no integers.
arcnow.io's own PlatformConfig on the multi-quote stack, the one new launches use. 1,000,000 total
supply, 790,931.776678561246309959 of it on the curve (79.09%), 209,068.22 held back for the pool,
and a 50 USDC graduation target. Opening price 0.000016710135998192 USDC, graduation price
0.000239156382570519 - the 14.31x of version 1, reached convexly. Set by arcnow-io/contracts
SetCurveTemplate in derive mode; equal to ArcConstants TESTNET_* and to vectors.json 'testnet'.
The platform serves the SAME six wads for EURC (read back at the same block), which is why
there is no second entry here: a snapshot per quote would duplicate one template and give
check-template.sh two chances to disagree with itself. It reads the native one.
arcnow-io/contracts' reference version-2 template, ArcConstants REFERENCE_*: 1e9 tokens and a
50,000 USDC target at the 14.312x multiplier. No live platform serves it (the version-2 platform
deployed with it and moved to the testnet template before anything launched). The same prices
as arc-testnet at a thousand times the supply and the target.
There is no Arc mainnet deployment, so there is no platform to read a
template off. null rather than a copy of testnet's: a plausible-looking
template for a chain that does not exist is exactly the kind of constant
this file exists to stop shipping.
